original_submission.content:
import csv, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rows = list(csv.reader(open('storage/shared/atlas/overlays/stability_refit.csv')))[1:]
w = [float(r[0]) for r in rows]
ethos_delta = [float(r[2]) for r in rows]
stability = [float(r[3]) for r in rows]
entropy = [float(r[4]) for r in rows]
topo_proxy = [0.7 + 0.3*(1-e) for e in entropy]  # Proxy from 1356 scan
plt.scatter(w, ethos_delta, c=topo_proxy, s=[100*st for st in stability], cmap='plasma')
for regime in [3.25, 3.0, 6.0]: plt.axvline(regime, color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Regime {regime}')
plt.xlabel('w'); plt.ylabel('ethos_delta'); plt.colorbar(label='topo_proxy'); plt.legend()
plt.savefig('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/topo_integrated_panel.png')
print('Topo-integrated panel generated.')
